goal.line: Assemble the monthly investment report in USD and SGD.
goal.why: To map and automate the process as requested by the data team.
readers: Daniel Foo, the Chief Investment Officer

steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.does: Downloads the administrator positions export and the trading system positions export (CSV) from the portals and saves them to the shared file drop under /MonthEnd/<yyyy-mm>/raw. Opens each file, counts the rows and compares the row count and control total in the footer line with the file.
steps.control: Row count and file totals match the file (batch_control_totals).
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.does: Opens the cash tab of her reconciliation workbook (Cash_Recon_<yyyy-mm>.xlsx) and pastes the administrator cash balances beside the trading export balances, one row per entity (EG-HOLD, EG-TRUST, EG-B) per day. A formula column shows the difference. Anything over the 5,000 USD tolerance is highlighted by hand and a break case is opened in the tracker (tab 'Breaks'). Raj is told by email.
steps.control: Difference per entity per day inside cash_tolerance (5,000 USD).
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case (Entity B, 12,400 USD on 8 Oct 2026).

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.does: Saves the PDF to the manager folder, types the fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker (Excel), and checks the tracker against the expected list. For anything late or missing she writes a follow-up email to the manager by hand. Quarterly funds (C, D, E) are carried forward in the months with no statement.
steps.control: Every expected statement received by statement_due (10 business days).
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.does: Takes the holdings values from the tracker and the cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end in the market data file. The conversion is typed in, not linked, so a changed USD figure does not flow through.
steps.control: WMR 4pm fixing of the period end (fx_fixing).

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. If a late statement revises a value by more than 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund, the review is reopened.
steps.control: Maker never checker; estimates only in the investment report (estimate_use).
steps.exception: A revision over cio_materiality reopens the review.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.does: Reads the issued pack. The pack shows the version and the cutoff time. Questions for managers are logged as open questions and picked up by Mei in the next cycle.
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.

steps.name: Collect the exports
steps.does: Downloads the administrator positions export and the trading system positions export (CSV) from the portals and saves them to the shared file drop under /MonthEnd/<yyyy-mm>/raw. Opens each file, counts the rows and compares the row count and control total in the footer line with the file.
steps.control: Row count and file totals match the file (batch_control_totals).
steps.exception: A rejected file is re-requested the same day.

steps.name: Check cash against the administrator
steps.does: Opens the cash tab of her reconciliation workbook (Cash_Recon_<yyyy-mm>.xlsx) and pastes the administrator cash balances beside the trading export balances, one row per entity (EG-HOLD, EG-TRUST, EG-B) per day. A formula column shows the difference. Anything over the 5,000 USD tolerance is highlighted by hand and a break case is opened in the tracker (tab 'Breaks'). Raj is told by email.
steps.control: Difference per entity per day inside cash_tolerance (5,000 USD).
steps.exception: Over tolerance opens a break case (Entity B, 12,400 USD on 8 Oct 2026).

steps.name: Collect manager statements
steps.does: Saves the PDF to the manager folder, types the fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker (Excel), and checks the tracker against the expected list. For anything late or missing she writes a follow-up email to the manager by hand. Quarterly funds (C, D, E) are carried forward in the months with no statement.
steps.control: Every expected statement received by statement_due (10 business days).
steps.exception: Late or missing: follow-up draft to the manager.

steps.name: Convert to SGD
steps.does: Takes the holdings values from the tracker and the cash from the recon workbook and converts them to SGD in a separate Excel file, looking up the WMR 4pm USD/SGD fixing for the period end in the market data file. The conversion is typed in, not linked, so a changed USD figure does not flow through.
steps.control: WMR 4pm fixing of the period end (fx_fixing).

steps.name: Review and approve the report
steps.does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. If a late statement revises a value by more than 100,000 USD or 0.5% of a fund, the review is reopened.
steps.control: Maker never checker; estimates only in the investment report (estimate_use).
steps.exception: A revision over cio_materiality reopens the review.

steps.name: Read the report
steps.does: Reads the issued pack. The pack shows the version and the cutoff time. Questions for managers are logged as open questions and picked up by Mei in the next cycle.
steps.exception: Questions to managers logged as open questions.
